opening.garageHint: Drawn as an overhead door that rolls up into the garage with its cover's position. Its sun patch is under Daylight.

settings.title: Settings

settings.scanTimeoutHint: Raise it if Load Mesh times out on a large mesh
settings.debugLoggingHint: Writes spatial_context_debug.log in your config folder — ids and counts only
settings.weatherHint: Clouds dim the sunlight through windows: no beam when it's overcast, just soft sky light.
settings.lightCountHint: Show "2 of 3 lights on" under each room's name. Hovering a room shows it either way.
settings.roomBordersHint: The outline around every room. A selected room always shows one.
settings.labelHaloHint: The outline behind each room name that keeps it readable over lines and colour.
settings.fillUnderHint: Draw room colours beneath the background image, so counters, appliances and other items already in the drawing stay on top.
settings.scaleLineHint: The dashed line from Set Scale and its length. It always shows while you set the scale, and never on dashboards.

confirm.resetProperty: Reset the property view? This clears every building placement, every outdoor device and the background photo. Nothing is permanent until you hit Save afterward.
confirm.resetFloor: Reset "{floor}"? This clears every room, wall, opening, placed device, and the background image on this floor. Nothing is permanent until you hit Save afterward.
confirm.applyAlignment: Apply this alignment to "{floor}"? This rewrites every room, wall, door/window, and placed device position on that floor — plus its background image's placement and, if this floor has one set, its scale calibration too — to match this floor's coordinate system. This saves immediately and cannot be undone.

svgImport.alsoBackground: Also replace this floor's background with the SVG? (Cancel keeps the current background and only adds the geometry.)

furniture.calibrate: Set this floor's scale (Set Scale) for true-to-life sizes.
furniture.importHint: Add your own drawings: pick one or more .svg files. They're saved with your settings and work on every floor and on dashboards.
furniture.importFailed: Couldn't import {names}: not an SVG file, or larger than 300 KB.
furniture.deleteIcon: Remove this icon from the library
furniture.deleteIconConfirm: Remove “{name}” from the library? Items already placed show as an empty outline.
furniture.iconColors: Use the file's own colours (otherwise drawn in the item's line colour)

compass.title: North is {dir} of the plan's top
compass.noLocation: Set your home location in Home Assistant (Settings → System → General) for daylight that follows the sun.

view3d.noWebgl: This browser can't show 3D (WebGL is unavailable).
view3d.dollhouseHint: Stack every floor of this building
view3d.roofHint: Put a roof on the building (hidden while the floors are spread apart)
view3d.sunTime: Time of day for the sun
view3d.exportHint: Download the scene as a glTF (.glb) file
view3d.floorElevationHint: Height of this floor above the building's ground level, for stacking split levels in Dollhouse. Leave empty to stack it a full storey above the floor below.
view3d.scansIntro: Import a room scan exported from a phone scanning app as glTF (.glb or .gltf). It's stored with this integration and laid over the plan.
view3d.deleteConfirm: Delete the scan "{name}"? This can't be undone.
view3d.alignHint: Line the scan up with the plan: drag it on the floor, nudge and turn it, or let Auto-align square it to the walls.
view3d.autoAlignHint: Turn the scan to the plan's walls, snap its edges to the nearest wall faces and set its floor level
view3d.snap: Snap to walls (hold Shift to place freely)
view3d.roofPartsHint: Draw the roof from parts instead of working it out from the rooms, one per line: a rectangle of the plan (x0, y0, x1, y1 in plan units), its ridge along "x" or "y", eave height in metres (as Floor height, or [low side, high side]), pitch (rise per metre: 0.5 is 6/12) and ends (["gable" | "hip" | "open", the same]). Optional: overhang, base, gable "shake". Shared by every floor of the building.
view3d.roofInvalid: Those roof parts aren't valid: each needs x0, y0, x1, y1, ridge, eave and pitch.
view3d.groundHint: For a house on a slope: the ground's height on its high side and its low side (the same scale as Floor height), and which way it falls. A walk-out basement sits below the high side. Shared by every floor of the building.
view3d.scanModeHint: Show the room scans' walls and objects in place of the plan's walls and furniture (the scans' stairs always show)
view3d.roofLightsHint: A row of LEDs along the fascia of the roof's edges (eaves and gable rakes) facing the picked sides, plus any edges ticked below: lit in its light's colour and brightness, like Hue Festavia permanent lights.
view3d.roofLightsRestart: Restart Home Assistant to save the roof lights; until then they last only until the page reloads.
view3d.roofLightsPatternNone: Default pattern: the light's own colour
view3d.roofLightsPatternHint: Home Assistant reports one colour per light, so a Hue scene's mix of colours can be set here: these colours run along the strip in turn, repeating, at the light's brightness while it's on.
view3d.roofLightsScenesHint: While one of these scenes is the one last activated, its pattern shows; otherwise the default pattern. Starred scenes are the light's room's or set the light.
view3d.roofLightsNeedParts: Roof lights run along a roof drawn from parts: set the roof's parts (Room scans → Roof parts) first.

edit3d.editHint: Edit the floor in 3D: walls, doors, windows, objects, floors and wall finishes
edit3d.selectHint: Click a wall, door, window, object or floor to select it. Drag the selected thing to move it (hold Shift to move freely). Double-click a wall to add a corner. Delete removes it, R turns an object, Ctrl+D copies it.
edit3d.wallHint: Click to place the wall's corners (they snap to other walls, a 5 cm grid and 45°; hold Shift or Alt to place freely). Double-click, press Enter or click the first corner to finish; Esc cancels.
edit3d.openingHint: Click a wall to put it there (hold Shift to place more). Esc stops.
edit3d.objectHint: Pick something, then click the floor to place it (hold Shift to place more; R turns it first).
edit3d.outdoorHint: Pick a light or a plant. Click a wall to hang a wall light: the face it goes on is outlined, and it snaps level with the other wall lights (purple) and centred on the wall, a gap or a door, or mirroring a light across a door (green). Click the ground for the rest; spotlights turn to the nearest wall. Hold Shift to place freely, R turns it first. Drag a wall light to slide it along its wall.
edit3d.restartNeeded: Restart Home Assistant to save floor and wall finishes and object heights; everything else is saved.
edit3d.name: Name
edit3d.halfWallHint: A half wall: a metre high with a cap, for a landing or a stairwell's edge.
edit3d.wallDragHint: Drag the wall to move it square to itself, or drag a corner's dot. Walls and floors joined to it follow.
edit3d.openingDragHint: Drag it along its wall, or onto another wall.
edit3d.roomHint: The walls' covering and colour apply to the faces of the walls looking into this room. Floor level raises or lowers this room (a split level's landing).
edit3d.yardHint: Pick what to lay, then click the ground to place its corners (they snap to the yard's other pieces, joining their corners and edges and lining up with them in teal, square or parallel to an edge nearby, and to the house's walls, a 5 cm grid and 45°; hold Shift to place freely). Double-click or press Enter to finish; click the first corner to close a fence or hedge into a loop. Backspace takes back a corner, Esc cancels.
edit3d.yardSurfaceHint: A surface: click round its outline (at least three corners). Round its corners into curves once it's placed.
edit3d.yardLineHint: A line: click along it (two corners or more). Once it's placed, Curve rounds its corners: a curved retaining wall, fence or edging.
edit3d.gradeHint: Drag over the ground to shape it with the brush: raise a hill or berm, lower a swale, flatten, smooth out lumps, or return the ground to the site's own grade. The brush works fully inside the inner ring and eases off out to the outer ring (Feather). The ground runs smoothly between the grid's points; the house keeps its foundation.
edit3d.gradePointHint: Drag across the ground to lay the grid's points over an area (up to 900; Grid spacing sets how close they are). Then press a point's dot and drag up or down (it snaps to 5 cm; hold Shift for free), or click a point and type its height in Point height. The ground curves smoothly between points.
edit3d.brushFeatherHint: How far past the brush's radius each dab eases off into the ground round it (the outer ring). More feather blends a raise or dip in gently; none gives a crisp edge.
edit3d.resetGradeConfirm: Level the ground back to the site's plain grade, removing every hill and swale?
edit3d.gradeRestartNeeded: Restart Home Assistant to save the grading; until then it lasts only until the page reloads.
edit3d.raiseBlend: Blend (edges not along a retaining wall)
edit3d.outlineHint: Drag it to move it over the ground, or drag a corner's dot. The small blue dots mid-edge add a corner: drag one out (or click it), then curve the corners. Click a dot, then Delete to remove it.
